payload.text: One line assembler serves a file and a command alike. Bytes are split on 0x0A, each complete line is decoded with bad bytes as U+FFFD, and a fragment is held until its newline arrives, so a character split across two reads stays one character. At a stream's end the fragment held is a line. No line is longer than 256 KiB: a longer run with no newline is given up in pieces, each ending on a character's boundary, so what is held stays bounded.
